title: Chapter 3. THE ARRIVAL OF THE WIZARD
chineseTitle: 第3章 魔法师的到来

paragraphs.en: The children entered the glass palace through a large doorway and found themselves in a grand hall. People gathered around the edges, leaving the horse and buggy and the man with the star in the center.
paragraphs.zh: 孩子们通过一扇大门口进入了这座玻璃宫殿，发现自己置身于一个宏伟的大厅。人们聚集在四周，留下了一辆马车和中央那位手持星星的男子。

paragraphs.en: "Come to us, oh, Gwig!" called the man loudly.
paragraphs.zh: “哦，吉格！来我们这里！”那人大声喊道。

paragraphs.en: A cloud of smoke appeared, spreading into the dome and revealing a strange figure on a glass throne. He was bald, with sharp thorns covering his head, face, and hands, even his nose. Dorothy laughed at his appearance.
paragraphs.zh: 一团烟雾突然出现，弥漫开来，露出了一个坐在玻璃王座上的奇异身影。他光着头，头上、脸上乃至手上都长满了尖刺，连鼻子上也不例外。多萝西见状不禁笑了出来。

paragraphs.en: The Sorcerer noticed her laughter and glared coldly at her, making her quickly sober.
paragraphs.zh: 巫师注意到她的笑声，冷冰冰地瞪着她，让她迅速收起了笑容。

paragraphs.en: "Why have you intruded your unwelcome presence into the Land of the Mangaboos?" he demanded sternly.
paragraphs.zh: “你为何不请自来的闯入了芒加布 land？”他严厉地问道。

paragraphs.en: "We couldn't help it," replied Dorothy.
paragraphs.zh: “我们没法控制自己,”多萝西回答道。

paragraphs.en: "Why did you send the Rain of Stones to damage our houses?" he continued.
paragraphs.zh: “你为什么要降下石雨毁坏我们的房屋？”他继续问道。

paragraphs.en: "We didn't do that," declared Dorothy.
paragraphs.zh: “我们没有那样做。”多萝西坚定地说道。

paragraphs.en: "Prove it!" cried the Sorcerer.
paragraphs.zh: “证明它！”术士喊道。

paragraphs.en: "You don’t need proof; we know it was an earthquake," Dorothy retorted indignantly.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西愤然反驳道：“不需要证据，我们知道那是地震。”

paragraphs.en: The man with the star looked at the Sorcerer and asked, "You said there would be no second Rain of Stones. Yet another one just occurred. What good is your sorcery if it can't tell us the truth?"
paragraphs.zh: 那个手持星辰标志的人看着术士，问道：“你说不会再有第二次石雨。可是又发生了。你的法术既然不能告诉我们真相，还有什么用？”

paragraphs.en: "My sorcery tells the truth!" declared the thorn-covered man. "I said only one Rain of Stones.
paragraphs.zh: “我的妖法说的都是实话！”荆棘覆盖的男人宣称，“我只说过一次石雨。”

paragraphs.en: The second was a mix of people and things, including stones."
paragraphs.zh: 第二部分则是一些杂乱无章的东西，包括石头。

paragraphs.en: "Will there be more Rains?" asked the man with the star.
paragraphs.zh: “还会再来雨人吗？”那颗星星般的人问道。

paragraphs.en: "No, my Prince," replied the Sorcerer.
paragraphs.zh: “不，我的王子,”施法师回答道。

paragraphs.en: "Neither stones nor people?"
paragraphs.zh: “石头还是人？”

paragraphs.en: "No, my Prince," he confirmed.
paragraphs.zh: “不，我的王子，”他确认道。

paragraphs.en: The Sorcerer remained seated as a man rushed into the hall and announced, "More wonders in the air, my Lord."
paragraphs.zh: 巫师仍坐在原位，只见一个人匆匆闯入大厅，喊道：“我的 lord，又有奇事发生。”

paragraphs.en: Prince and his people hurried outside to witness what was unfolding. Dorothy and Zeb quickly followed, while the Sorcerer stayed calm.
paragraphs.zh: 王子和他的臣民急忙走出宫殿，目睹正在发生的一切。多萝西和泽布迅速跟上，而巫师则保持冷静。

paragraphs.en: High above, a balloon-like object descended slowly through the sky, drawing everyone's attention. The crowd stood still, unable to move or hasten its descent. Dorothy and Zeb watched with excitement; a balloon suggested another visitor from Earth might arrive.
paragraphs.zh: 高空中，一个气球状的物体缓缓降落，吸引了所有人的目光。人群愣在原地，无法移动或加快它的下降速度。多萝西和泽布兴奋地注视着；气球的到来预示着可能又有来自地球的访客要到来。

paragraphs.en: After an hour, they saw a basket hanging beneath the balloon. Two hours later, a head appeared over the side of the basket. Finally, as the balloon settled into the square, it came to rest on the glass pavement.
paragraphs.zh: 一小时后，他们看见一个篮子悬挂在热气球下方。又过了两小时，从篮子里探出一个脑袋。最终，随着热气球缓缓降落到广场上，它停在了玻璃铺装的地面上。

paragraphs.en: A small man jumped out, removed his tall hat, and bowed gracefully to the crowd. He was an elderly man with a bald head.
paragraphs.zh: 一位矮小的老人跳了出来，摘下高高的帽子，优雅地向众人鞠了一躬。他光着头，显得有些年迈。

paragraphs.en: "Dorothy!" she exclaimed in surprise. "It's Oz!"
paragraphs.zh: “多萝西！”她惊讶地喊道，“是奥兹国！”

paragraphs.en: The Wizard turned towards her, equally surprised but then smiled and bowed. "Yes, my dear; I am Oz, the Great and Terrible," he said. "And you are little Dorothy from Kansas."
paragraphs.zh: 巫师转向她，同样显得惊讶，随后却露出了微笑，并微微鞠了一躬。“是的，我的亲爱的；我是奥兹，伟大的可怕的巫师，”他说，“而你就是来自堪萨斯的小多萝西。”

paragraphs.en: Zeb whispered to Dorothy, "Who did you say it was?"
paragraphs.zh: 泽布小声对多萝西说：“你说的是谁？”

paragraphs.en: "It’s the wonderful Wizard of Oz. Haven't you heard of him?" she replied.
paragraphs.zh: “这就是那位神奇的奥兹 wizard。你没听说过吗？”她脱口而出。

paragraphs.en: The man with the star approached and stood before the Wizard.
paragraphs.zh: 那个手持星星的男人走近，站在了巫师面前。

paragraphs.en: Sir, why are you here in the Land of the Mangaboos? asked the man. "I didn't know it was a land, my son," replied the other with a smile.
paragraphs.zh: 先生，您怎么会来到芒加布王国呢？那人问道。“我还以为那只是一个传说中的地方呢，我的儿子。”另一人微笑着回答。

paragraphs.en: "And I didn’t mean to visit when I started out. I live on top of the earth, your honor, which is better than inside it. Yesterday, in a balloon, I let too much gas out and couldn’t rise again.
paragraphs.zh: “其实我一开始并没有打算来访。陛下，我住在地表之上，这比在地下要好。昨天我在气球里放出了太多气体，结果再也升不起来了。”

paragraphs.en: The earth closed over me, and here I am."
paragraphs.zh: 大地覆住了我，而我就在这里。”

paragraphs.en: The Prince listened attentively. "This child from the earth called you a Wizard," he said. "Is a Wizard like a Sorcerer?"
paragraphs.zh: 王子认真地听着：“这个来自地球的孩子称你为巫师，”他说，“那么巫师和术士有什么区别呢？”

paragraphs.en: "It’s better," Oz replied promptly. "One Wizard is worth three Sorcerers."
paragraphs.zh: “这样更好，”奥兹迅速回答道，“一个巫师顶三个术士。”

paragraphs.en: "Prove it," said the Prince. "Our Mangaboos have one of the best Sorcerers, but he makes mistakes. Do you ever make them?"
paragraphs.zh: “那就证明给我看，”王子说道，“我们的芒加布王国有一位非常出色的巫师，但他也会犯错。你也会犯错吗？”

paragraphs.en: "I never do!" declared Oz boldly.
paragraphs.zh: “我从不这样做！”奥兹大胆地宣称。

paragraphs.en: "Oh, Oz!" Dorothy interjected. "You made many mistakes in the Land of Oz."
paragraphs.zh: “哦，奥兹！”多萝西插嘴道，“你在奥兹国犯了不少错误。”

paragraphs.en: "Nonsense!" said Oz, turning red as a violet ray illuminated his face.
paragraphs.zh: “胡说八道！”奥兹说着，脸色因紫光的照射而变得通红。

paragraphs.en: The Prince led him to meet their Sorcerer. The Wizard followed reluctantly but entered the great domed hall with Dorothy and Zeb. There sat the thorny Sorcerer.
paragraphs.zh: 王子领着他去见他们的巫师。巫师勉强跟着，但还是和多萝西与泽布一起走进了那座宏伟的圆顶大厅。在那里坐着那位棘手的巫师。

paragraphs.en: When the Wizard saw him, he laughed, making comical little chuckles.
paragraphs.zh: 当巫师看到他时，不禁笑了起来，发出一阵滑稽的笑声。

paragraphs.en: "What an absurd creature!" he exclaimed.
paragraphs.zh: “真是个荒唐的东西！”他脱口而出。

paragraphs.en: "He may look absurd," said the Prince quietly. "But he is a good Sorcerer. The only fault I find is that he often makes mistakes."
paragraphs.zh: 他说：“他可能看起来有些滑稽，”王子平静地说，“但他确实是一位不错的巫师。我唯一觉得遗憾的是，他经常犯错。”

paragraphs.en: "Only recently did you tell me there would be no more Rain of Stones or People," said the Prince.
paragraphs.zh: “你最近才告诉我不会再有石雨或是人雨了，”王子说道。

paragraphs.en: "Well, what then?" replied the Sorcerer.
paragraphs.zh: “那又怎样？”巫师回答道。

paragraphs.en: "Here is another person from the air to prove you were wrong," said the Prince.
paragraphs.zh: “又来了一个从空中来的证人，证明你错了。”王子说道。

paragraphs.en: The Sorcerer declared, "One cannot be called 'people.' If two appeared from the sky, I might be wrong. But unless more than one appears, I stand by my claim."
paragraphs.zh: 巫师宣布：“不能称其为‘人们’。如果只有两个人从天而降，我或许会改口。但除非出现更多人，否则我的说法依旧成立。”

paragraphs.en: "Very clever," said the Wizard, nodding. "I find humbugs everywhere, just like on top of the earth. Have you ever been to a circus, brother?"
paragraphs.zh: “非常高明，”巫师点头说道，“我发现骗子无处不在，就像在地面上一样。你曾经去过马戏团吗，兄弟？”

paragraphs.en: "No," replied the Sorcerer.
paragraphs.zh: “不,”巫师回答道。

paragraphs.en: "You should join one," declared the little man seriously. "I'm part of Bailum & Barney's Great Consolidated Shows—three rings in one tent and a menagerie on the side. It’s a fine aggregation."
paragraphs.zh: “你应该加入一个。”矮个子男人认真地说，“我隶属于贝卢姆与班尼的盛大联合演出——一顶帐篷里有三个表演环，旁边还有动物表演。这可是一个不错的组合。”

paragraphs.en: "What do you do?" asked the Sorcerer.
paragraphs.zh: “你做什么工作？”巫师问道。

paragraphs.en: "I usually go up in a balloon to draw crowds to the circus," said the Wizard. "But I've had bad luck, coming out of the sky and landing lower than intended. But never mind; not everyone gets to see your Land of the Gabazoos."
paragraphs.zh: “我通常乘坐热气球升空，吸引人们来马戏团观看,”巫师说道，“但这次运气不佳，从空中降落得比预期低了许多。不过没关系；并不是每个人都能看到我的加巴祖星球。”

paragraphs.en: "Mangaboos," corrected the Sorcerer. "If you are a Wizard, you should call people by their right names."
paragraphs.zh: “芒加布斯，”巫师纠正道，“如果你是巫师，就应该叫人名正言顺的称呼。”

paragraphs.en: "Oh, I'm a Wizard, just as good as you are a Sorcerer," said the little man.
paragraphs.zh: “哦，我也是个巫师，跟你一样出色。”那个矮小的男人说道。

paragraphs.en: "That remains to be seen," said the other.
paragraphs.zh: “这还有待观察。”另一个人说道。

paragraphs.en: "If you prove better," said the Prince to the Wizard, "you'll become Chief Wizard. Otherwise—"
paragraphs.zh: “如果你更强些，”王子对巫师说，“你将成为首席巫师。否则——”

paragraphs.en: "What will happen otherwise?" asked the Wizard.
paragraphs.zh: “否则会怎么样？”巫师问道。

paragraphs.en: "You’ll stop living and be forbidden from being planted," replied the Prince.
paragraphs.zh: “你将停止生长并被禁止再次种植。”王子回答道。

paragraphs.en: "That does not sound pleasant," said the little man, looking at the one with the star uneasily. "But I'll beat Old Prickly."
paragraphs.zh: “这听起来不太令人愉快，”那个矮小的男人不安地看了看那位头顶星星标记的人，说道，“但我得教训一下老刺头。”

paragraphs.en: "My name is Gwig," said the Sorcerer, turning his cruel eyes on his rival. "Watch me perform sorcery to prove my claim."
paragraphs.zh: “我的名字是古威,”术士说道，将他那冷酷的目光投向对手，“看我施展魔法来证明我的说法。”

paragraphs.en: He waved a thorny hand, and sweet music began to tinkle from invisible bells. Dorothy searched but found no actual bells in the great glass hall.
paragraphs.zh: 他挥舞着一根带刺的手指，空气中响起悦耳的铃声。多萝西四处寻找，却在那座巨大的玻璃厅中未发现任何实际的铃铛。

paragraphs.en: The Mangaboo people listened but showed little interest; it was one of Gwig's usual tricks to demonstrate his powers.
paragraphs.zh: 芒加boo人听了但兴趣不大；这不过是吉威格平时施展魔法的惯用伎俩。

paragraphs.en: The Wizard began his demonstration with a show of his empty hat. He shook it upside down for the audience's inspection. The Sorcerer then examined the hat closely before returning it.
paragraphs.zh: 巫师首先展示了他的空帽子，将它颠倒过来让观众检查。随后，术士仔细端详了那顶帽子，才将其放回原位。

paragraphs.en: "Let me see," said the Sorcerer, taking the hat and inspecting it thoroughly.
paragraphs.zh: 巫师拿起帽子，仔细端详了一番，说道：“让我看看。”

paragraphs.en: "Now, I will create something from nothing," declared the Wizard. Placing the hat on the glass floor, he waved his hand and removed it to reveal a tiny piglet no bigger than a mouse. The creature began running around, grunting and squealing.
paragraphs.zh: “现在，我要从无中创造有。”巫师宣布道。他把帽子放在玻璃地板上，挥了挥手，然后取下帽子，露出了一个比老鼠还小的猪仔。那小家伙开始四处奔跑，哼唧个不停。

paragraphs.en: The people watched in amazement as the Wizard caught the piglet and split it into two separate ones. He placed one back on the floor and repeated the process until nine small piglets were scurrying about his feet.
paragraphs.zh: 人们目瞪口呆地看着巫师捉住小猪崽，将其一分为二，变成了两个独立的小猪。他将其中一个放回地上，反复这个过程，直到脚下有九只小巧玲珑的小猪在四处乱窜。

paragraphs.en: "Now," said the Wizard, "I will make something nothing again." He gathered two of the piglets and pushed them together, then added another to form a single creature. One by one, he reduced the nine piglets to just one, which he placed under his hat with a mystical gesture.
paragraphs.zh: “现在，”巫师说道，“我要让一些东西再次变成 nothing。”他把两只小猪聚在一起，又加了一只，形成了一个单独的生物。一个个地，他将九只小猪缩减成一只，并用一个神秘的手势把它放在了帽子下。

paragraphs.en: When he removed it, the last piglet had vanished.
paragraphs.zh: 当他取下围栏，最后一头小猪已经无影无踪。

paragraphs.en: The Wizard bowed to the silent crowd, and the Prince commented, "You are indeed a wonderful Wizard, your powers surpassing those of my Sorcerer."
paragraphs.zh: 巫师向静默的观众鞠了一躬，王子评论道：“您确实是一位了不起的巫师，您的法力远超我的术士。”

paragraphs.en: "Your reign as a wizard will be short," Gwig remarked. "I can stop your breath; I see that you cannot survive without it."
paragraphs.zh: “你的巫师生涯不会长久。”古威remarked道，“我能让你停止呼吸；我看得出来，你无法离开它而生存。”

paragraphs.en: The little man looked worried. "How long will it take?" he asked.
paragraphs.zh: 矮个子男人显得有些焦虑：“需要等多久？”他问道。

paragraphs.en: The Wizard began making strange gestures towards the Sorcerer. However, the little man quickly took out a leather case and assembled several sharp knives into a long sword. As he attached the handle, he struggled to breathe due to the Sorcerer's spell.
paragraphs.zh: 巫师开始向施法者做出奇怪的手势。然而，那矮小的男人迅速掏出一个皮套，将几把锋利的小刀组装成了一柄长剑。他一边固定剑柄，一边因施法者的咒语而喘不过气来。

paragraphs.en: Without delay, the Wizard raised the sword, spun it around his head, and delivered a powerful strike that split the Sorcerer in two. Dorothy screamed, expecting a gruesome sight, but saw only two halves of what looked like a sliced turnip or potato.
paragraphs.zh: 没有拖延，巫师举起宝剑，在头顶旋转了一圈，然后一击重劈，将术士从中劈为两半。多萝西惊叫起来，本以为会看到令人作呕的景象，却只见两截看起来像切开的芜菁或土豆一般的东西。

paragraphs.en: "Why, he’s vegetable!" exclaimed the Wizard, surprised.
paragraphs.zh: “他竟然是个植物人！”巫师惊讶地喊道。

paragraphs.en: "Of course," said the Prince. "We are all vegetables here. Are you not also?"
paragraphs.zh: 当然，”王子说道，“我们这里人人都像是植物。你不也是吗？”

paragraphs.en: "No," replied the Wizard. "People on top of the earth are made of meat."
paragraphs.zh: “不，”巫师回答，“地球上的人都是由肉做成的。”

paragraphs.en: The Sorcerer was indeed dead and would wither quickly. They must plant him to grow more Sorcerers from his bush, explained the Prince.
paragraphs.zh: 巫师确实已经死了，而且会迅速枯萎。王子解释说，他们必须将他埋葬，在他的枝条上培育出更多的巫师。

paragraphs.en: "What do you mean by that?" asked the little Wizard, puzzled.
paragraphs.zh: “你这话是什么意思？”小巫师困惑地问道。

paragraphs.en: "If you come with me to our public gardens," replied the Prince, "I can explain better there how our Vegetable Kingdom works."
paragraphs.zh: “如果你跟我一起去公共花园，”王子回答说，“我可以在那里更好地为你解释我们的蔬菜王国是如何运作的。”
